d:
On the auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, SM Production presentation in association with Hungama & Canvas Talent brings you the song "Tutari" in the melodious voice of Shankar Mahadevan. It's time to welcome Lord Ganesh in Bollywood style. This track will bring out the crazy in you as you happily get into the festive spirit. Ganpati Bappa Moraya!
Singer: Shankar Mahadevan
Music: Shankar Mahadevan
Music Producer: DAWgeek
Lyrics: Sameer Samant
:::::Additional Song Details::::::
Music Supervisor: Siddharth Mahadevan
Live Rhythm: Dipesh Varma, Satyajit Jamsandekar & Siddharth Mahadevan.
